questions.question: Explain the term access control policy.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the term access control policy /[CO1]
  • Access control policy defines who (users or processes) can access
  • what resources and under what conditions . It ensures
  • confidentiality, integrity, and availability by restricting
  • unauthorized access.Policies are based on principles like least
  • privilege and need-to-know.Common types include Discretionary
  • Access Control (DAC) , Mandatory Access Control (MAC) , and
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
  • Explanation, common types etc – (5 marks)

  • financial data.

  • executives.
  • Smishing: Phishing through SMS messages.
  • Vishing: Voice-based phishing attacks via phone calls pretending
  • to be legitimate sources.

questions.question: Write the uses of tunneling protocols in VPN
questions.solution_html:
• Write the uses of tunneling protocols in VPN. /[CO3]
  • Tunneling protocols encapsulate data packets to create a secure
  • communication channel over public networks. Provide data
  • confidentiality through encryption during transmission. Ensure data
  • integrity and authentication of communicating parties. Common
  • VPN tunneling protocols: PPTP, L2TP, IPsec, SSL/TLS, and
  • OpenVPN. Used for remote access , secure communication , and
  • bypassing geographic or network restrictions.
  • Explanation – (5 marks)
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain how encryption protects mobile apps.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain how encryption protects mobile apps. /[CO1]
  • Encryption converts sensitive app data into unreadable form,
  • protecting it from unauthorized access. Safeguards stored data (at
  • rest) and transmitted data (in transit) . Prevents data leakage if a
  • device is lost or compromised. Protects communications between
  • app and server using SSL/TLS encryption . Ensures compliance
  • with security standards and user privacy protection.
  • Explanation – (5 marks)

questions.question: Illustrate the dangers of weak cryptography in web applications. [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Illustrate the dangers of week cryptography in web
  • applications.
  • /[CO3]
  • Weak cryptography can be easily broken, leading to data breaches
  • and unauthorized access. Enables attackers to decrypt sensitive
  • information like passwords or financial data. Makes web
  • applications vulnerable to man-in-the-middle (MITM) and replay
  • attacks. Affects user trust and may lead to legal and reputational
  • damage. Using strong, modern algorithms (e.g., AES, SHA-256)
  • helps prevent such vulnerabilities
  • Explanaton – (5 marks)
